cd /workspace/project && PYTHONPATH=src python3 - <<'PY'
import json,time
from eywa.offline import CampaignCompiler
from eywa.state import MachineRuntime
camp=json.load(open('/workspace/tmp/big2.json'))
t=time.perf_counter(); comp=CampaignCompiler(camp); print('compile',time.perf_counter()-t)
mr=comp.machine
orig_bits=mr._enabled_bits; orig_build=mr._build_graph
stats={'bits':0,'build':0,'nb':0,'ng':0}
def bits(scope):
 s=time.perf_counter();r=orig_bits(scope);stats['bits']+=time.perf_counter()-s;stats['nb']+=1;return r
def build(bits):
 s=time.perf_counter();r=orig_build(bits);stats['build']+=time.perf_counter()-s;stats['ng']+=1;return r
mr._enabled_bits=bits;mr._build_graph=build
t=time.perf_counter();res=comp.execute();print('execute',time.perf_counter()-t,stats)
